answer_2.quote: We report a few different measures. The first measure we report is the average F1 score... Another measure we used is average WindowDiff (WD)... We also measured the average Segmentation Similarity (S-SIM) and Boundary Similarity (B-SIM) scores... For the topic assignment we used python's difflib SequenceMatcher (SM) scores... Another measure we used is the Damerau-Levenshtein edit distance.

answer_4.quote: The annotation was carried out by two trained annotators, highly proficient in English. Evaluating on the 7 documents that were annotated by both annotators, we achieve Boundary score = 0.324, Sequence Matching = 0.4 and Edit distance = 0.73.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators segmented testimonies and assigned topics according to the provided annotation guidelines.
